business_summary: Bonne Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells cosmetics in South Korea and internationally. The company offers baby and infant shampoos, rinses, lotions, creams, oils, personal care products, and bath products; bath oils/tablets/capsules, bath salts, bubble baths, and other bath products; foam cleansers, body cleansers, liquid soaps, external genital cleansers, wet wipes, and other body cleansing products; eyebrow pencils, eyeliners, eye shadows, mascara, eye makeup removers, and other eye makeup products; perfumes, powdered incense, sachets, colognes and other scented products; and Hair tints, hair color sprays, hair dyes, bleaching, bleaching products, and other hair dyeing products. It also provides blush, face powder, face cake, liquid, cream, cake foundation, makeup base, makeup fixative, lipstick, lip liner, lip gloss, lip balm, body painting, face painting, makeup products, and other color cosmetics products; hair conditioner, hair tonic, hair grooming aid, hair cream, hair lotion, hair oil, pomade, hair spray, mousse, wax, gel, shampoo, rinse, permanent wave, hair straightener, and other hair products; fingernails and toenails products; shaving products; basic cosmetic products; deodorants and other anti-odor products; and depilatory creams and other hair removal products. In addition, the company engages in the cosmetics and health food import and export business; cosmetics processing business; and real estate rental business. It is also involved in chemical manufacturing, advertising service, cosmetics wholesale and retail business. Further, it offers detergent-related products and toothpaste, as well as manufactures and distributes lamps. Bonne Co., Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
